orphan_listeners.name: DispatchKdsTicket
orphan_listeners.reason: Lives at app/Listeners/DispatchKdsTicket.php but is NOT registered in EventServiceProvider::$listen as an event listener. Instead it is invoked DIRECTLY as a service via dependency injection in app/Services/KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php (line 21+32+34+36 constructor injection). Confusing namespace placement (Listeners/) for a service-style invocable — consider relocating to app/Services/Kitchen/ to avoid auditor whiplash.

findings.title: Orphan event ComposerProfilePublished dispatched without consumer
findings.evidence: app/Services/Composer/ComposerProfileService.php:168 calls ComposerProfilePublished::dispatch((int) $fresh->id) but EventServiceProvider::$listen has zero mapping for this class. ComposerProfileChanged (sibling event) IS wired. Either ComposerProfilePublished is dead code or a wiring TODO.
findings.impact: Silent no-op dispatch — no domain_events row, no broadcast, no listener side-effects. If a consumer was intended (e.g., kiosk push notification on composer wizard publish), it is missing in production. Low blast radius today because the dispatch is paired with a sibling event that already triggers catalog refresh, but the intent ambiguity is a documentation/maintenance debt.
findings.recommendation: Either wire ComposerProfilePublished into $listen (mirror ComposerProfileChanged) or delete the dispatch line + event class to reduce confusion.

findings.title: DispatchKdsTicket misplaced in app/Listeners/ but used as service-invocable, not an event listener
findings.evidence: app/Listeners/DispatchKdsTicket.php is constructor-injected into app/Services/KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:32+34+36 as $kdsTicketDispatcher and called directly. It is NOT registered in EventServiceProvider::$listen. Auditor expectation when scanning app/Listeners/ is: every file is referenced by $listen. This violates that invariant.
findings.impact: Auditor whiplash + 'orphan listener' false positive during structure audits. No runtime defect — just namespace hygiene.
findings.recommendation: Move to app/Services/Kitchen/Dispatching/KdsTicketDispatcher.php (or similar) and update the import in KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService. Pure refactor, no behavior change.

findings.title: StockDecrementFailedEvent dispatched without consumer — ops blind to stock failures
findings.evidence: DecrementStockOnOrderCreated:46 and DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder:53 both call event(new StockDecrementFailedEvent(...)) wrapped in try/catch ('dispatch absorbed'). EventServiceProvider::$listen has no mapping. No domain_events row, no broadcast, no log persistence beyond Log::warning at the dispatch site.
findings.impact: Stock decrement failures (per-order P1 stock leak scenarios) emit an event that goes nowhere. Ops gets at most a Log::warning entry that may be drowned by other log noise. No pager-grade alerting like the HEAL B.2 OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent escalator. If FK ever needs proactive 'stock_decrement_failed > 5 in 1h => page on-call', the listener slot is empty.
findings.recommendation: Mirror HEAL B.2 pattern — wire StockDecrementFailedEvent -> a new EscalateStockDecrementFailed listener that emits Log::channel('fiscal')->critical with structured payload (order_id, branch_id, sku, qty, exception_class). 30-min implementation, closes the ops blind spot.
